name: @vwl/contracts
description: Smart contracts for VWL (Gate 7: NodeRegistry, ProjectRegistry, Escrow, VestingSettlement)

scripts.test: if command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$HOME/.config/.foundry/bin/forge" ]; then export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.config/.foundry/bin"; forge test; else echo 'Foundry forge not found, skipping EVM differential tests'; fi
scripts.build: if command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$HOME/.config/.foundry/bin/forge" ]; then export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.config/.foundry/bin"; forge build; else echo 'Foundry forge not found, skipping EVM build'; fi
